newsitem.title: DUBAI: ENOC and Caltex form company to produce engine oil.
newsitem.headline: ENOC and Caltex form company to produce engine oil.

text.p: The Dubai Emirates National Oil Company (ENOC) said on Tuesday it had set up a joint company with Caltex to produce and market engine oil and lubricants.
Caltex is a 50-50 joint venture between Chevron Corp and Texaco Inc.
The new company will be responsible for producing and selling these products in the United Arab Emirates, the state-run news agency WAM added.
Under the deal, the joint entity took over an engine oil company that was run by Caltex in Dubai, it added.
The agency gave no further details and company officials were not immediately available for comment.
